normalization_plan.reason: The referr parameter is only used inside addIn to set the referrer mapping entry.
The amount parameter is only used inside withdraw for the balance check and transfer.
The winNum local is the direct result of the timestamp-derived winner index computation.
The loop counter i is only a temporary artifact of the referral payout loop in addIn.
The addr local only holds an intermediate referrer address during addIn payouts.
The last local is just the return value assembled by getLastGame.
The winer local is just the winner return value assembled by getLastGame.
